payload.note: Units of foreign currency per GBP 1, the shape HMRC publishes for customs and VAT at https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/exchange-rates-for-customs-and-vat -- one file per month, published at the end of the preceding month and fixed for the whole of that month. A price with an as_of date outside `period` has no rate here and refuses as a missing instrument (ADR-0020). These rates are ILLUSTRATIVE, in HMRC's published shape and magnitude: 2026-08 is not a month HMRC has published, and nothing here is a fetch of HMRC's file. Every other feed in this estate marks its provenance the same way.
